# Interaction

An interaction: agents working on a task together, defined once and run many times. It is one-shot (one agent answers), round-robin (agents take turns in one conversation) or managed (a manager agent hands work to others).

**Kind:** one of several shapes, used in responses.

## Shapes

The `$type` field says which shape it is, and comes first.

| `$type` | Shape |
|---|---|
| `"managed"` | [`ManagedInteraction`](managed-interaction.md) |
| `"one-shot"` | [`OneShotInteraction`](one-shot-interaction.md) |
| `"round-robin"` | [`RoundRobinInteraction`](round-robin-interaction.md) |
